lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of approximately six horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots, with the largest and most distinct clusters aligned along the primary mid-lateral ridge posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher pixel intensity are visible, creating a grid-like pattern where circular spots are situated at the nodes of intersection between these vertical bands and the longitudinal carinae.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the lateral flank; the primary mid-lateral ridge exhibits a sharp vertical gradient transition from high-intensity reflectance on its upper edge to dark shadow on its lower edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin displays a sparse distribution of high-luminance blobs, primarily located in the basal and mid-sections of the fin silhouette, with the apical region exhibiting a lack of spotting.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct high-intensity white mark is visible on the distal tip of the lower caudal fin lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: A cluster of approximately ten small teleost fish is visible in close proximity to the ventral surface of the pectoral fin.
